title: LLMProf Host Capabilities Reference
description: Reference document listing all host capabilities available to plugins via call_host_capability, including their input/output schemas and scope restrictions.

add_message_activity.description: Add one or more activity entries to a message's activity log. Activities are visible in the UI and via the message activity API. The message is resolved automatically from the execution token's message_id claim — no key or message reference needs to be passed.
add_message_activity.scope_restrictions: The plugin must be installed in a scope that has access to the target message. The host validates that the message belongs to a context/surface the plugin is associated with.

activity.description: A single activity entry to add.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the activity.

origin.description: Plugin name or label shown as card source.

icon.description: Icon name (e.g. Books, MagnifyingGlass, Info). Defaults to Info.

phase.description: Optional phase label for grouping activities.

activities.description: Multiple activity entries to add (alternative to 'activity').

success.description: Whether the activity entries were successfully added.

resolve_context.description: Resolve the current context for this plugin execution. The context is derived from the execution token's message_id claim (message → chat → context). Returns the context UUID and name, or null when no message is available.

resolve_message.description: Resolve the current message for this plugin execution. The message is identified by the message_id claim in the execution token. Returns the message ID, or null when no message is available.

request_system_model.description: Request an LLM completion from the system-configured model. The host manages the model selection, API keys, and rate limiting.
request_system_model.scope_restrictions: Only available to plugins installed in a context or surface scope. Personal-scope plugins cannot call this capability. The host enforces token and rate limits.

model.description: Optional model override. If omitted, the system default is used.

messages.description: Array of message objects with role and content.
Alternative to request.messages: top-level messages array.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for structured output. If provided, the host requests a structured response.

tool_definitions.description: Optional tool definitions for function calling. The host will pass these to the model.

result.description: The model completion result, including content, tool calls, and usage metadata.

request_user_i18n.description: Request the current user's locale/i18n preference. Useful for localizing plugin output.
request_user_i18n.scope_restrictions: Available in all scopes. Returns null if the user has no locale preference set or if the request is made outside a user context.

input.description: Empty object — no input parameters required.

locale.description: The user's locale string (e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr') or null if not set.
